description: Venture around Crack Mountain on this lesser used trail to reward yourself with spectacular views of the surrounding area at various viewpoints along the way.
directions: When travelling on Hwy 7 the trail head can be located at the west end of the weigh station area at N 49* 23.095 and W 121* 28.429. Cross over the railroad tracks and look for flagging tape on a cement block to the left. You will quickly come to a junction at which you should take the left fork to begin the hike.
title: Crack Mountain Trail
